question: My spouse is coming to Canada with me. Can we count money in our joint account as proof of funds for Express Entry?

quotes.text: If your spouse is coming with you, you can count money you have together in a joint account.
quotes.title: Documents for Express Entry: Proof of funds

answer_raw: Yes, if your spouse is coming with you, you can count money you have together in a joint account.
